units.source_text: “我父亲有点古怪，近来渐渐讨厌起做买卖来了。

en.t: My father is a little eccentric, and lately he has gradually come to dislike doing business.

units.source_text: 我们家嘛，是经销各种布料的杂货批发店，不可能净卖好料子。

en.t: Our family runs a wholesale dry goods shop that deals in all kinds of cloth, so we cannot sell only the finest fabrics.

units.source_text: 再说，现在化纤品和毛织品也多起来……”

en.t: Besides, synthetic fibers and woolen goods have become more common these days...
